title: Browser viewport stream — per-hop counter line
description: One object per hop per second. Emitted even when every value is zero: a freeze is a run of zeros, and a hop that goes silent must not look the same as a hop that died.

v.description: Contract version. Bump only on a breaking change; readers must ignore lines whose v they do not know.

hop.description: Emitting stage. A hop only ever emits its own value; no hop enumerates another's.

t.description: Unix seconds of the wall-clock-aligned window START. Primary join key across hops.

win_ms.description: Actual window length in ms. Nominally 1000; report the real value so a late or coalesced tick is detectable rather than silently skewing rates.

fi.description: Frames (or messages) accepted into this hop during the window.

fo.description: Frames handed to the next hop during the window.

drop.description: Total frames lost inside this hop. MUST equal the sum of dr's values.

dr.description: Drop counts by reason. Present only when drop > 0. Keys come from the hop's reason vocabulary in CONTRACT.md; an unknown key is a reader warning, never a parse failure.

idr.description: Access units containing an IDR. Only where the hop parses NAL types.

perr.description: Payloads this hop could not parse (no NAL, bad header, resync).

seq.description: Envelope seq observed this window. This is what makes per-frame loss localizable WITHOUT per-frame logging: if hop N reports 1200..1229 and hop N+1 reports 1200..1225, four frames died on that link. Omit when the hop saw no numbered frame.

first.description: Lowest seq seen in the window.

last.description: Highest seq seen in the window.

gaps.description: Count of discontinuities: occurrences of seq != previous + 1, within the window and across its boundary.

reset.description: True when seq went backwards — a daemon restart replays seq from 0, and every consumer must treat that as a new epoch rather than a 10^6-frame gap.

zero.description: True when fi, fo and drop were all 0 for the whole window. Redundant with the counters by design: it makes a freeze greppable without arithmetic.

edge.description: Present only on the extra out-of-band emit at a zero transition, which timestamps a freeze boundary precisely instead of quantizing it to the tick.

c.description: Cumulative twins since the stream opened. Survives a lost line: two non-adjacent lines still yield an exact total.

sid.description: Stream id. Phase 1b. Absent in phase 1a, where the join is t + the hop's own identity fields.

x.description: Hop-specific counters that have no meaning at other hops. Readers MUST ignore keys they do not know, so a hop can ship one without waiting on this schema. Anything that proves generally useful gets promoted to a top-level field and removed from here. Integers only: this is a counter channel, not a place to smuggle payload.
